## S1761: finite-type DM-stack smallness / orbicurve covers (2026-11-01)

- Task: after S1738, test whether Mathlib's affine finite-type bound proves
  `Small.{u}`/`EssentiallySmall` for finite-type DM etale stacks over a field,
  or for the actual `OrbicurveFiniteEtaleCover X`; list exact missing theorems.
- Verdict: the general theorem is **missing**.  Mathlib v4.32.2 has
  `Pseudofunctor.IsStack` and `essentiallySmall_costructuredArrow_Spec`, but no
  `AlgebraicStack`/`DMStack`, representable diagonal, unramified diagonal,
  etale atlas, stack quotient/stackification, or finite-type DM-stack smallness.
- Proved unconditionally: affine finite-type and affine finite-etale slice
  essentially small; strict 2-Yoneda for representable etale stacks (closes
  S1738's `S1738TwoYonedaRequired`); `Small.{u}` for raw strong-transformation
  types; every representable stack is an actual etale stack; the category of
  raw finite-etale descent data along arbitrary `s t : R ⟶ U` is
  `EssentiallySmall.{u}`, and so is every full subcategory (the cocycle
  subcategory).  Conditional on atlas descent, the actual cover category is
  `EssentiallySmall.{u}`.
- Exact missing inputs: (M1) DM/algebraic stack + atlas definitions;
  (M2) `S1761FiniteTypeDMAtlasExistence X := Nonempty (S1761FiniteTypeDMAtlas X)`;
  (M3) `S1761FiniteTypeDMCoverDescent X` (cover category equivalent to the
  cocycle full subcategory of `S1761RawDescent s t`); (M4) DM unramified
  diagonal; (M5) stack quotient/groupoid presentation descent; (M6) smallness
  of arbitrary finite-type schemes; (M7) smallness of the category of
  finite-type DM stacks.  Full list in `coord/reports/S1761-dm-stack-smallness.md`.
- File: `tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1761DMStackSmallnessActual.lean` (475 lines,
  21891 bytes, SHA256 3149FBEC192BB90098370B690A7AE0D40E6277A868C66046AF3E07F165DEBB01).
- Build: `lake env lean -o .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1761DMStackSmallnessActual.olean tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1761DMStackSmallnessActual.lean`; EXIT=0, no warnings, no `sorryAx`.
- Olean: 816744 bytes, SHA256 F907740077957C5D6125C115E607C8D77E497E3EB90E3341CF2EA97FDB6DB5F1.
- Axioms: every `#print axioms` reports only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`.  No Shrink/ULift/PLift/PUnit/sorry/axiom/fake category.
- Consumer: S1738 (2-Yoneda gap closed), S1733/S1743/S1755 (small cover
  category), S1728/S1732 D6 `OrbicurveFundamentalGroupData`.
- Next step: construct the identity atlas for the representable S1726
  orbicurve and prove its identity-groupoid descent equivalence, or add the
  missing DM-stack/atlas/quotient theory and then use
  `S1761FiniteTypeDMCoverSmallness_of_inputs`.

'@; Add-Content -Path AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Value $entry -Encoding utf8
